description: Bash parser corpus (§8.2, §13.1). Each expect lists only the keys that differ from `defaults`. Paths are relative to the starting cwd (POSIX-normalised, no trailing slash) unless absolute or '~/'. Rules: docs/crew/bash-parser.md.

entries.cmd:
cat > src/app/pos/new.ts <<EOF
export const x = 1;
rm -rf /
git commit --no-verify -m evil
HUSKY=0
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > README.md
export const x = 1;
rm -rf /
git commit --no-verify -m evil
HUSKY=0
EOF
cd src && cd app && rm pos/y.ts
pushd src/app/pos && touch z.ts && popd && touch root.ts
